summary.text: Sara Kyle is a Democratic state senator from Memphis representing Tennessee Senate District 30 (part of Shelby County), a member of the 109th through 114th General Assemblies. She is an attorney and serves on the Government Operations, Judiciary, and State and Local Government committees.

paragraphs.text: Kyle was born on October 21, 1952, and holds a J.D. from the Nashville School of Law.
She is married to Jim and has four children.
